name: Source Collaboration Access Request
description: Notifies an administrator when they have a pending access request for a collaborator who is configuring a source
subject: $owner requested Source Configuration Assignee access for $assignedUser
body:
Source Configuration Assignee Access Request

Dear $adminUser,

$owner has requested the Source Configuration Assignee user level for $assignedUser so they can onboard the $referenceName source.

Requester
$owner

Assignee
$assignedUser

Source
$referenceName

To grant this user level to $assignedUser, open their identity and enable the Source Configuration Assignee user level.

This user level must be assigned before they can begin onboarding this source. Contact $owner with any questions about this source or the assignee.

Thank you,
The $__global.productName Team
